name: blend_sleep_to_wake
blend_method: dense optical flow pose interpolation, crossfade-free (t<0.5 warped A, t>=0.5 warped B), lowest row interpolated
notes: Transition helper sleep -> wake: 3 in-between frames between the v2 boundary frames (sleep[-1] -> wake[0]). idle endpoints use idle_a frame 0 = idle_b frame 0 = idle still, so it connects both idle variants.
